description:
Search the SYNTHETIC demo inventory (about 860 fictional vehicles at 20 fictional dealers in TX, CA, FL, GA, AZ,
IL, NY and OH). Results are not real vehicles for sale; say so when you show them.
Each result has listing_id (dealer_key:VIN), vehicle basics, headline_price (before tax, title and fees), dealer_name,
and selling_location: the store that holds the unit, with address and phone. link_status is linked, or ambiguous
when the listing does not say which of the dealer's stores holds it (see selling_location_candidates). A unit can
be held at a sister store run by another dealer in the same group; operated_by_dealer_id then differs from dealer_id.
Matching is exact on vocabularies, so a total of 0 often means a wrong value: check the parameter descriptions,
widen radius_miles or drop a filter; a zero total also returns hints.
The named parameters are shortcuts. filters reaches every other attribute: for example
{"field": "canonical.vin", "op": "eq", "value": "<VIN>"} finds a VIN, {"field": "price_summary.doc_fee", "op": "range",
"max": 300}, {"field": "incentives[].label_raw", "op": "eq", "value": "Military Appreciation"}.
Payment search: payment_max / payment_min filter on a DEMO monthly finance estimate computed per listing from its
itemized out-the-door estimate (tax, title, registration, dealer fees) for the buyer location, minus down payment and
trade equity, at a demo APR by credit tier unless apr is given. Each result then has estimated_payment (rounded to
$5, with a range) and the response has payment_assumptions. Not an offer of credit; not penny-accurate.

FieldFilter.description: One generic filter on any ontology field (see list_searchable_fields).

field.description: Dotted field path from list_searchable_fields, e.g. canonical.exterior_color.family, price_summary.doc_fee, incentives[].label_raw, store.name, payment.estimated_monthly. Shortcut names such as make, model, color, price, state also work.
field.title: Field

op.description: eq exact (case-insensitive text); any_of with values; contains (text substring); range with min and/or max (numbers or ISO dates, inclusive); bool with value true/false; exists.
op.title: Op

value.description: Value for eq, contains, bool or exists.
value.title: Value

FieldFilter.title: FieldFilter

apr.description: APR percent for payment estimates. If omitted, a demo APR by credit_tier is used.
apr.title: Apr

body_style.description: suv, sedan, pickup, hatchback, minivan or wagon. Use pickup for trucks.
body_style.title: Body Style

buyer_city.description: Buyer's city for payment tax lines.
buyer_city.title: Buyer City

buyer_county.description: Buyer's county (without 'County') for payment tax lines.
buyer_county.title: Buyer County

buyer_state.description: Buyer's two-letter state for payment tax and fees. Default: the selling store's state.
buyer_state.title: Buyer State

buyer_zip.description: Buyer's ZIP; sets buyer state and city when buyer_state is omitted.
buyer_zip.title: Buyer Zip

city.description: Exact city of the selling store (for example Houston, Katy, Plano). Suburbs are separate cities, so for 'in or near a city' prefer zip plus radius_miles.
city.title: City

condition.description: new, used or cpo (certified pre-owned). used also returns cpo units.
condition.title: Condition

credit_tier.description: excellent, good (default), fair or poor; picks the demo APR when apr is omitted.
credit_tier.title: Credit Tier

dealer_key.description: Dealer key from list_dealers, e.g. lonemesa.
dealer_key.title: Dealer Key

down_payment.description: Cash down in USD for payment estimates. Default 0.
down_payment.title: Down Payment

exterior_color.description: Exterior color family: white, black, silver, gray, blue, red, green or bronze.
exterior_color.title: Exterior Color

filters.description: Generic filters on ANY ontology field (vehicle, listing, store, dealer, price, fee, incentive, media, payment). All filters must match. See list_searchable_fields.
filters.title: Filters

fuel_type.description: gasoline, hybrid, plug_in_hybrid or electric. Use electric for EV or BEV.
fuel_type.title: Fuel Type

include_payment.description: True to add estimated_payment to every result without filtering on it.
include_payment.title: Include Payment

limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Each result is about 2 KB; 5 to 10 is usually enough.
limit.title: Limit

make.description: Make, case-insensitive, e.g. Honda, Ford, Tesla. 14 makes are present.
make.title: Make

model.description: Model with its punctuation, case-insensitive: CR-V, F-150, Model 3, Mustang Mach-E.
model.title: Model

payment_max.description: Maximum estimated monthly finance payment in USD (demo estimate), e.g. 450.
payment_max.title: Payment Max

payment_min.description: Minimum estimated monthly finance payment in USD (demo estimate).
payment_min.title: Payment Min

payoff.description: Loan payoff owed on the trade-in, USD.
payoff.title: Payoff

price_max.description: Maximum headline price in USD (before tax, title and dealer fees). For a budget that includes taxes and fees, check estimate_out_the_door.
price_max.title: Price Max

price_min.description: Minimum headline price in USD (before tax, title and dealer fees).
price_min.title: Price Min

sort.description: price_asc (default), price_desc, year_desc, mileage_asc, distance_asc (needs zip), payment_asc or payment_desc.
sort.title: Sort

state.description: Two-letter code of the selling store's state: TX, CA, FL, GA, AZ, IL, NY or OH. Not the full name.
state.title: State

term_months.description: Loan term in months, 12 to 96. Default 60.
term_months.title: Term Months

trade_equity.description: Net trade equity in USD if allowance and payoff are unknown (negative for upside-down); no tax credit is applied for it.
trade_equity.title: Trade Equity

trade_value.description: Trade-in allowance in USD (gets the trade-in tax credit where the state allows it).
trade_value.title: Trade Value

trim.description: Trim name, e.g. LX, EX-L, Lariat.
trim.title: Trim

zip.description: Five-digit US ZIP of the shopper. With radius_miles, filters by straight-line distance to the selling store and adds distance_miles to each result.
zip.title: Zip

name: search_inventory
